sloka: यथा मां शुद्धचारित्रां दुष्टां जानाति राघवः ।तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः ।। ६.११९.२५ ।।
transliteration: yathā māṁ śuddhacāritrāṁ duṣṭāṁ jānāti rāghavaḥ ।tathā lokasya sākṣī māṁ sarvataḥ pātu pāvakaḥ ।। 6.119.25 ।।

translations.english: "If it is true that my heart has never slid from Raghava at all, may the fire god protect me always and so also the world witness."
